answer: Require each agent to post a bond of scarce tokens that is slashed if a randomly audited task reveals duplicate control or fabricated work. Audits can compare signed task histories and challenge agents to produce distinct, verifiable outputs; a shared operator risks losing every bonded identity tied to the same evidence. The jade, sable, and timber markets can each set bonds in their own tokens, but the rule is the same: a Sybil farm must lock up real capital and accept a growing loss risk, rather than minting identities for free.
